solar.name: Compact wings
solar.description: Light and cheap; limited electricity at Mars.

solar.name: Mapper wings
solar.description: Balanced arrays. Output falls with distance squared.

solar.name: Deep-space wings
solar.description: More electricity, more launch mass and cost.

battery.name: Reserve 300
battery.description: Small eclipse reserve; avoid running camera and radio together.

battery.name: Reserve 800
battery.description: Stores daytime energy for eclipse operations.

battery.name: Reserve 1600
battery.description: Longer operations in shadow, with a mass penalty.

camera.name: Survey imager
camera.description: Wide coverage, modest data. 12 m/pixel at 400 km.

camera.name: Mapping imager
camera.description: Sharper images need more power and storage.

camera.name: Precision imager
camera.description: Very sharp but data-heavy; needs accurate pointing.

comms.name: Low-gain link
comms.description: Very slow downlink can strand valuable images onboard.

comms.name: Mapper dish
comms.description: Directional antenna with useful data return.

comms.name: High-gain dish
comms.description: Fast downlink, but higher power draw and cost.

computer.name: Compact avionics
computer.description: Limited storage and slower image processing.

computer.name: Data workstation
computer.description: Holds many large images; uses extra power.

propulsion.name: Monopropellant
propulsion.description: Simple thruster; low specific impulse uses more fuel.

propulsion.name: Bipropellant
propulsion.description: Higher specific impulse improves manoeuvre efficiency.

propulsion.name: Efficient bipropellant
propulsion.description: Efficient chemical engine with higher dry mass and cost.

fuel.name: Lean tank
fuel.description: Only 120 kg propellant: capture may be impossible.

fuel.name: Transfer tank
fuel.description: 450 kg propellant for capture and corrections.

fuel.name: Extended tank
fuel.description: 650 kg propellant adds capability and launch mass.

attitude.name: Precision wheels
attitude.description: Accurate pointing keeps mapping images sharp.

thermal.name: Passive blanket
thermal.description: Low power but limited heat rejection during intensive work.

thermal.name: Mapper radiator
thermal.description: Rejects the heat of normal mapping operations.

thermal.name: Active thermal loop
thermal.description: Handles high power instruments with extra mass.
